The refinement is run at a 2000-digit working precision and converges to a residual
below 1e-1985. Two independent runs agree digit-for-digit on the first 1987 decimals;
beyond that the trailing digits are working-precision noise, so we quote 1950 and no
more. pslq_sweep.py holds back a 100-digit margin and searches at a 1900-digit
tolerance, which sits 87 digits inside the verified range.
